jobs.title: Client Relationship Officer

titleByLocale.fr: Agent de relations avec la clientèle

jobs.description:
Your team

The Pictet group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented in 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, currently employing over 4600 people. Pictet has been present in Singapore for more than 30 years where it employs over 200 people.

Pictet Asset Services provides custody, fund services and trading solutions for external asset managers, fund managers and institutional clients. We manage every aspect of the asset servicing value chain and our range of bespoke solutions include value-adding analytics, trading strategy support and digital front-end interfaces designed to provide an unrivalled customer experience.

Your role

This role support and develop Pictet Asset Services B2B client relationships in Asia by combining front-facing relationship management with strong operational and servicing capabilities, acting as a shadow Client Relationship Manager (CRM) while ensuring best-in-class day-to-day support. For the candidate with the appropriate credential and ambition, this position offers a potential pathway to a full CRM role in the future.

Key Responsibilities:

Client Relationship Officer

• Lead with complex account opening/closing, static data changes and onboarding of new services, ensuring completeness and accuracy of documentation.

• Provide daily operational support including but not limited to: processing and monitoring of payments, cash movements, securities orders, fund subscriptions/redemptions, and asset transfers.

• Handle client queries and incidents, ensuring timely resolution, proper escalation and clear communication to clients and internal teams.

• Verify the accuracy of transactions and data input in core banking and PAS tools; maintain up-to-date client files and internal records.

• Contribute to client satisfaction and retention through proactive, solution-oriented servicing and regular contact (calls, emails, meetings).

• Assist in coordinating internal stakeholders (Operations, Legal, Compliance, Credit, Trading, other PAS locations) to deliver a seamless client experience.
Promote collaboration and alignment of processes between Singapore and other PAS hubs (Geneva/Luxembourg).

• Contribute to keeping operating memoranda, procedures and checklists accurate and up to date as processes evolve.

Commercial Support / Relationship Management (Shadow CRM)

• Support senior MH/ CRMs in managing and developing relationships with existing Institutional clients including preparation for meetings and follow-ups.
Help build a comprehensive understanding of clients’ business models, objectives, challenges and decision-making processes.

• Support commercial initiatives (pricing analyses, fee schedules, KPIs, simple profitability views) and preparation of pitch or review materials for existing and prospective clients.

• Identify and flag opportunities for cross-sell / up-sell and process improvements to the CRM and Market Head.

Your profile

Education & Experience
• University degree or equivalent in Finance, Economics, Business or related field.
• 5–7 years’ experience in a Client Relationship Officer / Client Service / middle-office role in asset servicing, custody, or private banking; strong exposure to B2B clients (Asset Managers, Institutional clients, EAMs/GIs).
• Good understanding of banking and asset-servicing products, operational flows and securities / funds processing; knowledge of Avaloq or similar core banking system is an advantage.
• CMFAS / CACS certifications are an advantage.

Technical & Professional Skills
• Solid knowledge of asset-servicing operations: payments, cash sweeping, settlements, corporate actions, account opening and documentation.
• Strong client-facing skills with the ability to explain operational topics clearly and manage sensitive situations diplomatically.
• Good business mindset: able to understand revenue drivers, pricing considerations and commercial priorities.
• High proficiency with MS Office; comfortable working with internal banking systems and reporting tools.
• Excellent command of English; additional Asian language(s) a plus for regional client coverage.

Personal Competencies
• Enthusiastic, proactive and eager to learn, with a genuine interest in progressing towards a CRM role while still embracing hands-on CRO tasks.
• Strong team player able to work closely with colleagues across locations, while also operating independently when required.
• Well-organised, meticulous and able to manage multiple priorities under time pressure, with strong attention to detail and risk awareness.
• Service-oriented, solutions-driven and resilient, with excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

Diversity & Inclusion

Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace.

descriptionByLocale.it:
La tua squadra

Il gruppo Pictet è uno dei principali asset manager indipendenti al mondo. Fondato nel 1805 e con sede a Ginevra, in Svizzera, il Gruppo è rappresentato in 30 uffici nei centri finanziari di tutto il mondo, attualmente con oltre 4600 persone. Pictet è presente a Singapore da oltre 30 anni dove impiega oltre 200 persone.

Pictet Asset Services fornisce la custodia, i servizi di fondo e le soluzioni di trading per gli asset manager esterni, i gestori di fondi e i clienti istituzionali. Gestiamo ogni aspetto della catena del valore di manutenzione degli asset e la nostra gamma di soluzioni su misura includono analisi di valore, supporto strategia di trading e interfacce front-end digitali progettate per fornire un'esperienza clienti senza rivali.

Il tuo ruolo

Questo ruolo supporta e sviluppa le relazioni con i clienti di Pictet Asset Services B2B in Asia combinando la gestione dei rapporti front-facing con le forti capacità operative e di assistenza, agendo come un'ombra Client Relationship Manager (CRM) garantendo al contempo il miglior supporto giornaliero. Per il candidato con le credenziali e l'ambizione appropriate, questa posizione offre un percorso potenziale per un ruolo CRM completo in futuro.

Responsabilità chiave:

Responsabile relazioni cliente

• Condurre con l'apertura/chiusura di account complessi, le modifiche statiche dei dati e l'inserimento di nuovi servizi, garantendo la completezza e l'accuratezza della documentazione.

• Fornire supporto operativo giornaliero, compreso ma non limitato a: elaborazione e monitoraggio dei pagamenti, movimenti di cassa, ordini di titoli, abbonamenti di fondo/rimblazioni e trasferimenti di asset.

• Gestisci le richieste e gli incidenti dei clienti, assicurando una risoluzione tempestiva, una corretta escalation e una comunicazione chiara ai clienti e alle squadre interne.

• Verificare l'accuratezza delle transazioni e dell'ingresso dei dati negli strumenti di core banking e PAS; mantenere i file client aggiornati e i record interni.

• Contribuisci alla soddisfazione e alla ritenzione del cliente attraverso un servizio proattivo, orientato alla soluzione e un contatto regolare (call, email, riunioni).

• Assistere nel coordinamento delle parti interessate interne (Operazioni, Legale, Compliance, Credito, Trading, altre sedi PAS) per offrire un'esperienza client senza soluzione di continuità.
Promuovere la collaborazione e l'allineamento dei processi tra Singapore e altri hub PAS (Geneva/Lussemburgo).

• Contribuire a mantenere la memoranda operativa, procedure e liste di controllo accurate e aggiornate come i processi si evolvono.

Supporto commerciale / Gestione delle relazioni (Shadow CRM)

• Sostenere gli MH/CRM senior nella gestione e nello sviluppo dei rapporti con i clienti istituzionali esistenti, compresa la preparazione di riunioni e follow-up.
Aiuta a costruire una comprensione completa dei modelli aziendali dei clienti, obiettivi, sfide e processi decisionali.

• Sostenere le iniziative commerciali (analisi di partenza, programmi di pagamento, KPI, semplici opinioni sulla redditività) e la preparazione di materiali di pitch o review per i clienti esistenti e potenziali.

• Identificare e contrassegnare le opportunità per il cross-sell / up-sell e migliorare il processo al CRM e Market Head.

Il tuo profilo

Istruzione e esperienza
• Laurea o equivalente in Finanza, Economia, Business o campo relativo.
• Esperienza di 5–7 anni in un Customer Relationship Officer / Servizio Clienti / ruolo di middle-office nella manutenzione degli asset, custodia o private banking; forte esposizione ai clienti B2B (Asset Manager, clienti istituzionali, EAM/GIs).
• Una buona comprensione dei prodotti bancari e di asset-servicing, flussi operativi e elaborazione di titoli / fondi; la conoscenza di Avaloq o simile sistema core banking è un vantaggio.
• Le certificazioni CMFAS / CACS sono un vantaggio.

Competenze tecniche e professionali
• Conoscenza solida delle operazioni di asset-servicing: pagamenti, cash spazzamento, insediamenti, azioni aziendali, apertura del conto e documentazione.
• Forte capacità di affrontare il cliente con la capacità di spiegare chiaramente gli argomenti operativi e gestire situazioni sensibili diplomaticamente.
• Good business mindset: in grado di comprendere i driver di reddito, considerazioni sui prezzi e priorità commerciali.
• Alta competenza con MS Office; lavoro confortevole con sistemi bancari interni e strumenti di reporting.
• Ottimo comando dell'inglese; lingua asiatica aggiuntiva (s) un plus per la copertura clienti regionale.

Competenze personali
• Espressivi, proattivi e desiderosi di imparare, con un autentico interesse a progredire verso un ruolo di CRM, mentre ancora abbracciando i compiti di CRO.
• Forte giocatore di squadra in grado di lavorare a stretto contatto con i colleghi in tutte le posizioni, mentre funziona anche indipendentemente quando richiesto.
• Ben organizzato, meticoloso e in grado di gestire più priorità sotto pressione temporale, con una forte attenzione ai dettagli e alla consapevolezza del rischio.
• Service-oriented, soluzioni-driven e resiliente, con eccellente comunicazione e competenze interpersonali.

Diversità e inclusione

Pictet è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità e si impegna a creare un ambiente diverso. Rispettiamo tutti gli individui e cerchiamo la loro inclusione sul posto di lavoro.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Dein Team

Die Pictet-Gruppe ist einer der weltweit führenden unabhängigen Vermögensverwalter. Die 1805 gegründete Gruppe mit Hauptsitz in Genf, Schweiz, ist in 30 Büros in Finanzzentren weltweit vertreten und beschäftigt derzeit über 4600 Mitarbeiter. Pictet ist seit mehr als 30 Jahren in Singapur präsent und beschäftigt dort über 200 Mitarbeiter.

Pictet Asset Services bietet Depot-, Fondsdienstleistungen und Handelslösungen für externe Vermögensverwalter, Fondsmanager und institutionelle Kunden. Wir verwalten jeden Aspekt der Wertschöpfungskette des Asset Service und unser Sortiment an maßgeschneiderten Lösungen umfasst wertschöpfende Analysen, Unterstützung der Handelsstrategie und digitale Front-End-Schnittstellen, die ein konkurrenzloses Kundenerlebnis bieten.

Deine Rolle

Diese Rolle unterstützt und entwickelt die B2B-Kundenbeziehungen von Pictet Asset Services in Asien, indem sie ein nach vorne gerichtetes Beziehungsmanagement mit starken operativen und Servicefunktionen kombiniert, als Schatten-Client Relationship Manager (CRM) agiert und gleichzeitig einen erstklassigen täglichen Support gewährleistet. Für den Kandidaten mit dem entsprechenden Nachweis und Ehrgeiz bietet diese Position einen potenziellen Weg zu einer vollen CRM-Rolle in der Zukunft.

Wichtigste Aufgaben:

Client Relationship Officer

• Führen Sie mit komplexer Kontoeröffnung / -schließung, statischen Datenänderungen und der Einführung neuer Dienste, um die Vollständigkeit und Genauigkeit der Dokumentation zu gewährleisten.

• Bereitstellung täglicher operativer Unterstützung, einschließlich, aber nicht beschränkt auf: Verarbeitung und Überwachung von Zahlungen, Bargeldbewegungen, Wertpapieraufträgen, Zeichnungen/Rücknahmen von Fonds und Übertragungen von Vermögenswerten.

• Bearbeitung von Kundenanfragen und -vorfällen, um eine rechtzeitige Lösung, eine angemessene Eskalation und eine klare Kommunikation mit Kunden und internen Teams zu gewährleisten.

• Überprüfen Sie die Richtigkeit der Transaktionen und Dateneingaben in Kernbanking- und PAS-Tools; pflegen Sie aktuelle Kundendateien und interne Aufzeichnungen.

• Tragen Sie zur Kundenzufriedenheit und -bindung durch proaktives, lösungsorientiertes Service und regelmäßigen Kontakt (Anrufe, E-Mails, Meetings) bei.

• Unterstützung bei der Koordination interner Stakeholder (Operations, Legal, Compliance, Credit, Trading, andere PAS-Standorte), um ein nahtloses Kundenerlebnis zu bieten.
Förderung der Zusammenarbeit und Abstimmung der Prozesse zwischen Singapur und anderen PAS-Hubs (Genf/Luxemburg).

• Tragen Sie dazu bei, dass Betriebsmemoranden, Verfahren und Checklisten im Laufe der Prozesse korrekt und aktuell sind.

Commercial Support / Relationship Management (Shadow CRM)

• Unterstützen Sie leitende MH / CRMs bei der Verwaltung und Entwicklung von Beziehungen zu bestehenden institutionellen Kunden, einschließlich der Vorbereitung auf Meetings und Folgemaßnahmen.
Helfen Sie dabei, ein umfassendes Verständnis der Geschäftsmodelle, Ziele, Herausforderungen und Entscheidungsprozesse der Kunden aufzubauen.

• Unterstützung kommerzieller Initiativen (Preisanalysen, Gebührenpläne, KPIs, einfache Rentabilitätsansichten) und Vorbereitung von Pitch- oder Review-Materialien für bestehende und potenzielle Kunden.

• Identifizieren und markieren Sie Möglichkeiten für Cross-Selling / Up-Selling und Prozessverbesserungen für den CRM und Market Head.

Dein Profil

Bildung & Erfahrung
• Universitätsabschluss oder gleichwertig in Finanzen, Wirtschaft, Business oder verwandten Bereichen.
• 5-7 Jahre Erfahrung in einem Client Relationship Officer / Client Service / Middle-Office-Rolle in Asset Service, Depot oder Private Banking; starkes Engagement bei B2B-Kunden (Asset Manager, Institutionelle Kunden, EAMs / GIs).
• Gutes Verständnis von Bank- und Asset-Servicing-Produkten, operativen Strömen und Wertpapier- / Fondsverarbeitung; Kenntnisse des Avaloq oder eines ähnlichen Kernbankensystems sind von Vorteil.
• CMFAS / CACS-Zertifizierungen sind von Vorteil.

Technische und berufliche Fähigkeiten
• Solides Wissen über Asset-Servicing-Operationen: Zahlungen, Cash Sweeping, Abwicklungen, Kapitalmaßnahmen, Kontoeröffnung und Dokumentation.
• Starke kundenorientierte Fähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, operative Themen klar zu erklären und sensible Situationen diplomatisch zu bewältigen.
• Good Business Mindset: in der Lage, Umsatztreiber, Preisüberlegungen und kommerzielle Prioritäten zu verstehen.
• Hohe Kenntnisse mit MS Office; komfortables Arbeiten mit internen Banksystemen und Reporting-Tools.
• Ausgezeichnete Englischkenntnisse; zusätzliche asiatische Sprache(n) ein Plus für die regionale Kundenabdeckung.

Persönliche Kompetenzen
• Enthusiastisch, proaktiv und lernbegierig, mit einem echten Interesse daran, auf eine CRM-Rolle hinzuarbeiten und gleichzeitig praktische CRO-Aufgaben zu übernehmen.
• Starker Teamplayer, der standortübergreifend eng mit Kollegen zusammenarbeiten und bei Bedarf auch unabhängig arbeiten kann.
• Gut organisiert, sorgfältig und in der Lage, mehrere Prioritäten unter Zeitdruck zu verwalten, mit großer Aufmerksamkeit für Details und Risikobewusstsein.
• Serviceorientiert, lösungsorientiert und widerstandsfähig, mit exzellenter Kommunikation und zwischenmenschlichen Fähigkeiten.

Vielfalt & Inklusion

Pictet ist ein Arbeitgeber für Chancengleichheit und engagiert sich für die Schaffung eines vielfältigen Umfelds. Wir respektieren alle Menschen und suchen ihre Einbeziehung in den Arbeitsplatz.

Votre équipe

Le groupe Pictet est l'un des leaders mondiaux des gestionnaires de patrimoine et d'actifs indépendants. Fondé en 1805 et ayant son siège social à Genève, le Groupe est représenté dans 30 bureaux dans les centres financiers du monde entier, employant actuellement plus de 4600 personnes. Pictet est présent à Singapour depuis plus de 30 ans et emploie plus de 200 personnes.

Pictet Asset Services fournit des services de garde, des services de fonds et des solutions de négociation aux gestionnaires d'actifs externes, aux gestionnaires de fonds et aux clients institutionnels. Nous gérons tous les aspects de la chaîne de valeur de l'entretien des actifs et notre gamme de solutions sur mesure comprend l'analyse de la valeur ajoutée, le soutien de la stratégie de négociation et les interfaces front-end numériques conçues pour fournir une expérience client inégalée.

Votre rôle

Ce rôle soutient et développe les relations clientes de Pictet Asset Services B2B en Asie en combinant la gestion de la relation face à face avec de solides capacités opérationnelles et de service, agissant en tant que gestionnaire de relations client parallèle (CRM) tout en assurant un soutien quotidien optimal. Pour le candidat ayant les qualifications et l'ambition appropriées, ce poste offre une voie potentielle vers un rôle CRM complet à l'avenir.

Principales responsabilités :

Agent de relations avec la clientèle

• Diriger avec l'ouverture/fermeture complexe des comptes, les changements de données statiques et l'embarquement de nouveaux services, en assurant l'exhaustivité et l'exactitude de la documentation.

• Fournir un soutien opérationnel quotidien comprenant, sans s'y limiter, le traitement et le suivi des paiements, des mouvements de trésorerie, des ordres de titres, des souscriptions/remboursements de fonds et des transferts d'actifs.

• Traiter les demandes de renseignements et les incidents des clients, en veillant à leur résolution en temps opportun, à l'escalade appropriée et à la communication claire avec les clients et les équipes internes.

• Vérifier l'exactitude des transactions et des données saisies dans les outils de base des services bancaires et du PAS; tenir à jour les dossiers des clients et les dossiers internes.

• Contribuer à la satisfaction et au maintien de la clientèle par des services proactifs axés sur la solution et des contacts réguliers (appels, courriels, réunions).

• Aider à coordonner les intervenants internes (opérations, juridiques, conformité, crédit, négociation, autres emplacements du PAS) pour offrir une expérience client transparente.
Promouvoir la collaboration et l'alignement des processus entre Singapour et d'autres centres du PAS (Genève/Luxembourg).

• Contribuer à maintenir à jour les protocoles d'exploitation, les procédures et les listes de contrôle à mesure que les processus évoluent.

Soutien commercial / Gestion des relations (CRM Shadow)

• Appuyer les MH/CRM supérieurs dans la gestion et le développement des relations avec les clients institutionnels existants, y compris la préparation des réunions et des suivis.
Aider à acquérir une compréhension complète des modèles d'affaires, des objectifs, des défis et des processus décisionnels des clients.

• Appuyer les initiatives commerciales (analyses de prix, barèmes de frais, ICR, visions simples de la rentabilité) et la préparation de documents d'examen ou de pitch pour les clients actuels et éventuels.

• Identifier et signaler les possibilités de vente croisée/mise à jour et d'amélioration des processus au CRM et à Market Head.

Votre profil

Éducation et expérience
• Diplôme universitaire ou équivalent en finance, économie, affaires ou domaine connexe.
• 5 à 7 ans d'expérience en relations avec la clientèle / service à la clientèle / rôle intermédiaire dans le service d'actifs, la garde ou la banque privée; forte exposition aux clients B2B (gestionnaires d'actifs, clients institutionnels, MAE/GI).
• Une bonne compréhension des produits bancaires et des services d'actifs, des flux opérationnels et du traitement des titres et des fonds; la connaissance d'Avaloq ou d'un système bancaire de base similaire est un avantage.
• Les certifications CMFAS / CACS sont un avantage.

Compétences techniques et professionnelles
• Connaissance approfondie des opérations de services d'actifs : paiements, balayage des liquidités, règlements, actions de l'entreprise, ouverture de compte et documentation.
• De solides compétences face à la clientèle avec la capacité d'expliquer clairement les sujets opérationnels et de gérer les situations sensibles diplomatiquement.
• Bon état d'esprit des affaires: capable de comprendre les facteurs de revenus, les considérations de prix et les priorités commerciales.
• Haute compétence avec MS Office; travail confortable avec les systèmes bancaires internes et les outils de rapport.
• Excellente maîtrise de l'anglais; langue(s) asiatique(s) supplémentaire(s) un plus pour la couverture des clients régionaux.

Compétences personnelles
• Enthousiaste, proactif et désireux d'apprendre, avec un véritable intérêt à progresser vers un rôle CRM tout en embrassant les tâches mains-sur CRO.
• Joueur d'équipe fort capable de travailler en étroite collaboration avec ses collègues dans tous les endroits, tout en fonctionnant de façon indépendante au besoin.
• Bien organisé, méticuleux et capable de gérer plusieurs priorités sous pression temporelle, avec une grande attention aux détails et à la sensibilisation aux risques.
• Un service axé sur les solutions et résilient, avec une excellente communication et des compétences interpersonnelles.

Diversité et inclusion

Pictet est un employeur à chances égales et s'engage à créer un environnement diversifié. Nous respectons toutes les personnes et nous cherchons à les inclure dans le milieu de travail.

jobs.title: Alternative Investment Specialist
jobs.description:
Your team

The Pictet group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented in 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, currently employing over 4600 people. Pictet has been present in Singapore for more than 30 years where it employs over 200 people.

Pictet Alternative Advisors (PAA) is a leading alternative investment specialist with expertise in hedge funds, private equity and global real estate. The Geneva and London-based team constructs, manages and advises on portfolios of alternative investment solutions for institutional and private clients.

Your role

You will be a key member of Pictet’s alternatives platform in Asia, acting as a key product and investment expert for our private equity, real estate, hedge fund and broader private markets offering. You will partner closely with senior client‑facing teams to design, position and implement high‑conviction, bespoke alternative investment solutions for sophisticated private and institutional clients across the region.

Client marketing, pitching and portfolio design

• Lead the preparation and delivery of high‑impact pitches and marketing materials for alternative investment opportunities (new funds, switch ideas, co‑investments, portfolio solutions).

• Draft clear, compelling client communications on new Private Equity (PE)/ Real Estate (RE)/ Hedge Funds (HF) opportunities, corporate actions and implementation options.

• Take an active role in client meetings (in person and virtually), confidently articulating strategies, structures and portfolio allocations across PE/RE/HFs.

• Build differentiated portfolio proposals, including back tests, simulations and customized presentations for strategic prospects and existing relationships.

Client reporting and reviews

• Prepare high‑quality monthly and quarterly client reports, including fund‑level commentaries, performance and risk analysis, and portfolio review packs.

• Support strategic relationships by co‑leading or joining PWM Relationship Managers (RM)/ Investment Specialists (IS) in review meetings with top‑tier UHNW and institutional clients.

Client queries and mandate management

• Serve as a primary point of contact for mandate‑related queries across booked alternative investment mandates, ensuring timely and high‑quality responses.

• Take ownership of advisory mandates, proactively proposing funds, switches and rebalancing ideas in line with client objectives and house views.

Order taking and execution support

Dein Team

Die Pictet-Gruppe ist einer der weltweit führenden unabhängigen Vermögensverwalter. Die 1805 gegründete Gruppe mit Hauptsitz in Genf, Schweiz, ist in 30 Büros in Finanzzentren weltweit vertreten und beschäftigt derzeit über 4600 Mitarbeiter. Pictet ist seit mehr als 30 Jahren in Singapur präsent und beschäftigt dort über 200 Mitarbeiter.

Pictet Alternative Advisors (PAA) ist ein führender alternativer Investmentspezialist mit Expertise in Hedgefonds, Private Equity und globalen Immobilien. Das Team mit Sitz in Genf und London konstruiert, verwaltet und berät Portfolios alternativer Anlagelösungen für institutionelle und private Kunden.

Deine Rolle

Sie werden ein leitendes Mitglied der alternativen Plattform von Pictet in Asien sein und als wichtiger Produkt- und Anlageexperte für unser Private Equity-, Immobilien-, Hedgefonds- und breiteres Privatmarktangebot fungieren. Sie arbeiten eng mit leitenden Kundenteams zusammen, um überzeugende, maßgeschneiderte alternative Anlagelösungen für anspruchsvolle private und institutionelle Kunden in der gesamten Region zu entwerfen, zu positionieren und umzusetzen.

Kundenmarketing, Pitching und Portfoliodesign

• Führen Sie die Vorbereitung und Bereitstellung von wirkungsvollen Pitches und Marketingmaterialien für alternative Anlagemöglichkeiten (neue Fonds, Switch-Ideen, Co-Investments, Portfoliolösungen).

• Entwurf einer klaren, überzeugenden Kundenkommunikation zu neuen Möglichkeiten für Private Equity (PE) / Real Estate (RE) / Hedge Funds (HF), Unternehmensmaßnahmen und Implementierungsoptionen.

• Nehmen Sie eine aktive Rolle in Kundenbesprechungen (persönlich und virtuell) ein und artikulieren Sie Strategien, Strukturen und Portfoliozuweisungen in PE / RE / HFs.

• Erstellen Sie differenzierte Portfoliovorschläge, einschließlich Backtests, Simulationen und maßgeschneiderten Präsentationen für strategische Perspektiven und bestehende Beziehungen.

Berichterstattung und Überprüfungen von Kunden

• Erstellen Sie qualitativ hochwertige monatliche und vierteljährliche Kundenberichte, einschließlich Kommentaren auf Fondsebene, Performance- und Risikoanalysen und Portfolio-Review-Paketen.

• Unterstützen Sie strategische Beziehungen, indem Sie PWM Relationship Managers (RM) / Investment Specialists (IS) in Review-Meetings mit erstklassigen UHNW und institutionellen Kunden mitführen oder begleiten.

Client Queries und Mandat Management

• Als primäre Anlaufstelle für mandatsbezogene Anfragen über gebuchte alternative Anlagemandate hinweg dienen und zeitnahe und qualitativ hochwertige Antworten sicherstellen.

• Übernehmen Sie die Verantwortung für Beratungsmandate, indem Sie proaktiv Fonds vorschlagen, wechseln und Ideen in Übereinstimmung mit den Kundenzielen und Hausansichten ausbalancieren.

Auftragserfassung und Ausführungsunterstützung

• Koordinieren Sie Vorhandelsmaterialien im Einklang mit dem Verkaufsprozess in Asien (Fondsprospekte, Term Sheets, Risikoangaben), einschließlich interner Kapazitätsprüfungen und Transfers.

• Arbeiten Sie mit Middle Office, Operations und Rechtsteams zusammen, um eine reibungslose Ausführung, eine genaue Buchung und eine sorgfältige Nachverfolgung alternativer Anlagetransaktionen zu gewährleisten.

Interne Beratung, Plattformentwicklung und Schulung

• Handeln Sie als vertrauenswürdiger interner Berater für PWM IS/RM-Teams und behandeln Sie Fragen zum alternativen Anlageangebot von Pictet.

• Arbeiten Sie eng mit den PAA-Investmentteams zusammen, um die Pipeline, die Produktmerkmale und die Hausansichten in Einklang zu halten und die alternative Plattform für Asien zu gestalten und zu entwickeln.

• Präsentationen und Schulungen für RMs und andere interne Stakeholder, einschließlich Pre-Client-Briefings, um das Fachwissen über Alternativen im gesamten Franchise zu verbessern.

- Über 8 Jahre einschlägige Erfahrung in alternativen Investments, einschließlich Buy Side, Multi-Manager, Private Banking Advisory oder ähnlichen Rollen
- Erhebliches Engagement in Hedgefonds und/oder privaten Märkten.
- Starkes Verständnis von Portfoliokonstruktion, Performance und Risikometriken für alternative Strategien.
- Fähigkeit, komplexe Konzepte klar an Kunden zu kommunizieren.
- Starke analytische Fähigkeiten, Strenge und Aufmerksamkeit für Details.
- Erfahrung in der Verwaltung komplexer Strukturen, Dokumentation und Multi-Jurisdiktional Setups
- Bewährte Teamplayer mit einer kundenorientierten Denkweise und einem hohen Maß an Integrität.
- Fähigkeit, in einem schnelllebigen, unternehmerischen und Multi-Stakeholder-Umfeld gute Leistungen zu erbringen
- Hervorragende schriftliche und verbale Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Englisch und Mandarin, mit vertrauensvoller Interaktion mit ultra-hochwertigen, privaten und institutionellen Kunden in ganz Asien.

Vielfalt & Inklusion

Pictet ist ein Arbeitgeber für Chancengleichheit und engagiert sich für die Schaffung eines vielfältigen Umfelds. Wir respektieren alle Menschen und suchen ihre Einbeziehung in den Arbeitsplatz.

Marketing client, emplacement et design de portefeuille

jobs.description:
Your team

Corporate Functions includes the Group’s non-banking activities and employs more than 900 people. These functions are carried out by specialists with expertise across all business units and include the Communications, Compliance, Finance, Human Resources, Information Security, Internal Audit, Legal, Risk, Tax and Sustainability Office departments.

Based in Geneva, you will join the Group Sustainability Office (GSO), which supports the advancement of Pictet’s sustainability strategy across the firm. You will report to the senior impact manager and work day to day with the impact investment specialist who leads our impact investing platform, alongside the sustainability lead and members of the research team.

Your role

You will dedicate around 50% of your time to professionalising an internal platform created to run a multi-asset, multi-theme sustainability impact portfolio for the Wealth Management division. The platform is a Python and LLM-based application combining a PostgreSQL database, LLM-based agents and human-in-the-loop workflows for investment assessment, portfolio analytics and reporting. Your mission will be to help evolve the platform towards enterprise standards – cloud infrastructure, multiple users, security and governance – while continuing to extend what it can do.

The rest of your time will be dedicated to sustainability data and automation initiatives across the Group Sustainability Office. This can include developing sustainability integration tools for our investment teams, user-friendly dashboards for the GSO and ad-hoc data analysis to support ongoing GSO projects.

This is a hands-on role for someone equally at ease in a database, in a prompt, and in a meeting with the bank’s engineering, data, infrastructure and security teams.

You will be in charge of:

• Build and evolve the platform: Co-design data pipelines, LLM-based agents, analytics and reporting features with the business line, and build user-friendly GSO dashboards in coordination with Finance and Data teams.

• Own and understand the data : Identify, source and define required data, maintaining a single source of truth across schema, ingestion, data quality, versioning, auditability and large complex datasets.

• Industrialise with strong engineering: Move prototypes to the bank’s cloud infrastructure with secure, monitored multi-user access, and enforce solid testing, documentation, deployment and audit practices.

• Ensure trustworthy, cutting-edge AI: Implement evaluation, guardrails and human review for explainable outputs, while assessing and responsibly deploying new LLM and agent capabilities.

• Act as the interface: Translate between business and technical teams and navigate engineering, infrastructure, security and compliance stakeholders to get decisions made.

Your profile

• Experience : 1-3 years in data, AI or software roles.

• Data & engineering : Strong SQL and data management skills (pipelines, data quality, traceability) plus solid Python and modern practices (Git, code review, CI/CD).

• AI/ML, LLMs & GenAI: Solid understanding of AI/ML concepts, including generative AI and large language models, with hands-on experience using LLM APIs, prompt design, RAG/agentic patterns, and systematic evaluation of model output (eval sets, guardrails, human review) in real projects.

• Communication, autonomy & mindset : Able to turn loosely defined business needs into solutions, explain technical topics clearly to non-specialists, work autonomously in a large organisation, and constructively challenge the status quo to improve processes and outcomes.

• Motivation & language : Genuine interest in sustainable/impact investing (no prior domain experience required) and fluent in English.

• Nice to have: Experience with AWS or Azure; PostgreSQL/SQLAlchemy/FastAPI (or similar stack); working in financial services or another regulated industry; French.

Note

We will not accept any CVs via agencies.

Ref. SIDASA/LJ/YD

Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace.

jobs.title: Physical Security coordinator
jobs.description:
Votre équipe

La division Group Corporate Services offre aux clients et aux collaborateurs du groupe Pictet une gamme étendue de services; elle gère les bâtiments du siège du Groupe à Genève ainsi que ceux des filiales, succursales et bureaux de ce dernier en Suisse et à l’étranger, et en assure la sécurité physique.

Afin de renforcer l’équipe Management du département Physical Security , notre bureau de Genève recherche un/une:

Physical Security Coordinator (100%)

Votre rôle

Vous aurez pour mission d’assurer la gestion des accès et des incidents du Groupe en Suisse et à l’étranger. Vous contribuerez à la réalisation de contrôles des dispositifs de sécurité et suivrez les installations de contrôle d’accès.

Responsabilités :

• Gestion des accès et des incidents

Définir la stratégie des contrôles d’accès.
Gérer les droits d’accès physiques aux bâtiments et zones sensibles pour les différentes catégories de personnes.
Procéder à l’enregistrement technique des nouveaux collaborateurs et consultants.
Participer à la gestion des incidents techniques de sécurité (analyse, reporting, suivi des actions correctives).

• Contrôle, conformité et reporting

Réaliser des contrôles réguliers pour s’assurer du bon fonctionnement des dispositifs de contrôle d’accès.
Elaborer des procédures sur diverses thématiques de sécurité physique.
Répondre aux questions de sécurité physique pour les audits internes et externes.

• Gestion et maintenance des équipements

Suivre et assurer la maintenance des installations de contrôle d’accès: disponibilité des équipements, maintenance préventive et curative.
Suivre les interventions des prestataires techniques.
Participer à l’analyse des besoins techniques et à la définition des solutions.
Assurer, en collaboration avec la personne responsable des aspects de sécurité IT, le support technique, la maintenance et l’évolution des solutions de contrôle d’accès et de vidéo protection.

Votre profil

• Formation CFC dans un domaine technique ou informatique.

• Expérience significative dans le suivi préventif et curatif d’installations techniques de sécurité physique, de préférence dans un environnement bancaire ou à haut niveau de sécurité.

• Solides connaissances techniques au niveau des systèmes de contrôle d’accès.

• Connaissances des outils de gestion des accès physiques et des technologies de sécurité, un atout.

• Intérêt prononcé pour les dernières innovations en sécurité physique.

• Maîtrise du pack Microsoft Office, utilisation aisée des outils de gestion administrative.

• Organisation, priorisation et planification des tâches.

• Suivi rigoureux des dossiers et respect des délais.

• Vigilance et sens des responsabilités.

• Sens du service et de l’écoute.

• Proactivité et autonomie.

• Capacité à travailler en équipe et sur différents sujets en parallèle.

• Excellente maîtrise du français (C1 minimum), très bonne maîtrise de l’anglais (B2 minimum).

• Domicile en Suisse requis.

Réf.: SPSC/SBP/DM

Note

We will not accept any CVs via agencies

Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace.

Your team

The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented in 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, currently employing over 5000 people. Pictet has been present in Hong Kong for 40 years where it employs around 200 people.

Pictet Wealth Management combines more than 200 years of Swiss banking heritage with global investment expertise. The Partner-owned financial service group offers a comprehensive service for wealthy individuals and families including discretionary and advisory investment solutions and family office services.

Your role

Responsibilities:

• Coordinate the approval of new investment products for PWM Asia by the Asia Product Validation Committee.

• New investment products implementation and roll-out for PWM clients in Asia in coordination with all relevant business and control and corporate functions.

• Perform updates and revisions of contractual and other products and mandates related documents in collaboration with Legal departments in Hong Kong and Singapore.

• Perform daily operations related to investment mandates: onboarding process, constraints review and monitoring.

• Coordinate the Asia Customization Review Forum to ensure any mandate customization align with investment guidelines while identifying opportunities to optimize and scale operations for all mandates which are management by investment teams based in Asia.

• Collaborate with the investment teams to provide assistance to front teams on investment product availability and operations.

• Contribute to strategic projects and initiatives related to investment products.

• Support the preparation of the local regulatory reports related to investment products.

• Participate actively in the monthly run-the-bank meeting to represent the investment platform.

• Participate actively in the Operational Committee.

• Be the local topic owner for investment platform regulatory matters and Regulators interactions.

• Reporting structure:

• Functional/regulatory reporting to local CEO

• Business reporting to PWM Investment Platform Business Manager - Asia

Your profile

• 7 to 10 years of working experience in business and/or product management in wealth management or asset management

• Outstanding analytical and organizational skills with attention to detail

• A strong team player with excellent communication skills

• An ability to synthesize and present information clearly

• Bilingual proficiency in English and Chinese

jobs.title: Agentic AI Business Analyst - 9 months
jobs.description:
Your team

Pictet Asset Management is seeking to recruit an Agentic AI Business Analyst to strengthen the Operations, Transaction Management Solutions unit in London on a 9 month fixed term contract basis.

The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented in 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, currently employing over 5300 people. Pictet has been present in London since 1980, and employs near 400 people.

Pictet Asset Management manages the assets of some of the world’s largest institutions, financial intermediaries and their clients. Our culture welcomes independent thinkers and centres around investment excellence, a long-term perspective and a dedication to client service.

Our Operations teams, based across London, Geneva, and Singapore play a vital role in transaction lifecycle processing for all our investment strategies. Their aim is to provide Portfolio Managers with the most accurate, complete, and timely information they require to implement their chosen investment decisions. The team of four AI Business Analysts is responsible for identifying and shaping AI use cases, assessing their business value and technical feasibility, working with Technology and subject-matter experts to design and build the right solutions and implementing them within operational teams.

Your role

• Analyse existing business processes and identify opportunities for AI-driven workflow automation.

• Design, prototype and implement agentic AI solutions to streamline operational tasks.

• Collaborate with business and technology stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into automation use cases.

• Monitor, test and refine deployed automations to ensure reliability, control alignment and measurable impact.

• Document solutions (design, assumptions, risks, controls) and support knowledge transfer to end users.

• Contribute to the change management and adoption of new AI tools and workflows across PAM Operations.

• Ensure alignment with PAM standards and governance principles in the application of the PAM Agentic Framework.

Your profile

• Proven track record of successfully automating end to end workflow (ideally in an operations or financial services context).

• Knowledge of agentic AI concepts and tools (e.g. multi-step agents, orchestration frameworks, workflow engines or similar).

• Strong analytical and problem solving skills, with the ability to map and challenge existing processes.

• Adaptable mindset and openness to experimentation, iteration and learning from feedback.

• Ability to communicate complex technical concepts to non technical stakeholders.

• Experience with scripting or low-code/no-code automation tools is an advantage, and knowledge of Claude Code, Snowflake and SimCorp Dimension is a plus.

• Familiarity with data quality, controls and operational risk considerations is a plus.

You will thrive in a busy environment, have strong time management skills and show flexibility when reacting to changing priorities. You will be confident to present ideas, such as your developments, to your Team and Senior Management.

This role is perfect for someone who is eager to learn, thrives in a dynamic and collaborative environment, and is looking to make a meaningful contribution while developing their career.

REF:AAI/SH/CAY

Note

We will not accept any CVs via agencies

Diversity & Inclusion

Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace.

jobs.title: Internship - Funds Valuation
jobs.description:
Your team

The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented at 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, and currently employs over 5200 people. Pictet has been present since 1989 in Luxembourg, where it employs over 700 people.

FundPartner Solutions provides a full suite of fund administration and private label funds services. The global team of industry experts specialises in fund domiciliation, registration and governance, as well as risk compliance and investment management services.

Operations provide secure and efficient processing of Pictet’s banking transactions and investment funds. Our teams ensure all activities follow regulations and manage risks. By developing and maintaining a modern, robust infrastructure, we guarantee reliable, high-quality services for Pictet wealth management, asset management and real estate clients.

As an intern, you will work as part of the Valuation team , reporting directly to the team valuer head. In this role you will collect, analyse some audited financial statements of Hedge Funds, and analyze the governing body decisions in the NAV calculation process
A Valuer oversees the valuation for the funds under administration by FPS. His main objective is to provide the pricing of the funds of funds in accordance with the pricing methodologies, valuation policies, procedures and regulations.

Start Date : January 2027

Duration : 6 or 12 months

Working time : full time or part time (80%)

Internship agreement compulsory

Your role

· Analysis of the markets news regarding the Ukrainian Crisis
· Check the Governing Bodies decision in the NAV calculation process
· Collect of the Audited Financial Statements
· Back testing controls on Hedge Funds
· Draft evaluation procedures and work instructions

Your profile

· Good knowledge of financial products and their valuations,
· Outstanding analysis and redaction skills,
· Knowledge of data vendors such as Bloomberg or Telekurs,

jobs.title: Junior Researcher (fixed-term contract - 2 years programme)
jobs.description:
Your team

Corporate Functions includes the Group’s non-banking activities and employs more than 900 people. These functions are carried out by specialists with expertise across all business units and include the Communications, Compliance, Corporate Office, Finance, Human Resources, Information Security, Internal Audit, Legal, Risk, Strategy & Projects, and Tax departments.

The Pictet Investment Research Institute is an advanced investment research capability within Pictet Group, established in 2024.

The Institute’s goal is to conduct in-depth research on topics with long-term implications for Pictet’s business on topics ranging from geopolitics to macroeconomics to portfolio implementation issues.

We are looking for a recent PhD graduate to join the internal team of researchers and contribute to the research output of the Institute. The term of the contract is two years. At the end of the two-year period, the researcher will have the opportunity to be considered for permanent research positions within the Institute.

Your role

• Contribute to research projects of importance to the Pictet Institute.
• Work closely with the Head of the Pictet Institute to formulate the research methodology of the projects and perform the empirical analysis.
• Work closely with the other members of the Institute’s research team on advancing the individual projects, from the research stage to the completion and distribution of the published papers.
• Interact with academics affiliated with the Institute on matters related to the Institute’s research agenda.
• Contribute to writing the research papers on an as-needed basis.

Your profile

• PhD in Finance or a related field from an accredited institution. Individuals without a PhD will not be considered.
• Strong coding skills in Matlab, Python and SQL.
• At ease working with other researchers or investment professionals as well as alone, as necessary.
• Good communication skills, both oral and written, as well as ability to convey complex subject matters to a non-technical audience in a precise and concise manner.
• Excellent command of English.
• Must be willing and able to work in Geneva, Switzerland.

Note

We will not accept any CVs via agencies.

Ref.: JR/MH/MV

Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace.

jobs.title: Investment Specialist
jobs.description:
Your team

Pictet Wealth Management combines more than 200 years of Swiss banking heritage with global investment expertise. The Partner-owned financial service group offers a comprehensive service for wealthy individuals and families including discretionary and advisory investment solutions and family office services.

You will build “investment partnerships” with CRMs to deliver clients a unique investment experience aligned with their needs and geographical specificities. You will also assist CRMs in their business development efforts by identifying and presenting the most suitable investment solutions available (PWM, PAM and PAA).

Your role

• Communicating the investment platform’s strategy and solutions to CRMs, clients and prospects.
• Helping determine clients’ needs, identifying and developing new opportunities in partnership with CRMs, preparing investment/advisory proposals and portfolio reviews and helping convert prospects to clients.
• Developing, offering and servicing discretionary mandates and seeking to centralise their management.
• Overseeing advisory mandates, seeking to streamline positions and exposure and ensuring they remain consistent with the bank’s overall investment strategy and policy.
• Supporting the team head overall on various investment-related tasks.
This will entail:
• A full understanding of Pictet’s offering, policies and guidelines and attending relevant investment forums and presentations.
• An ability to present and defend the investment philosophy and mandate/product offering.
• Regular reviews of portfolios to monitor adherence to risk controls, compliance and client constraints.
• Executing and managing trade orders.
• Investing cash positions and managing, executing and reviewing client transactions.
• A full understanding and attribution of own advisory/managed portfolios’ performance.
• Knowledge of all available marketing documents and key resources within the Group.

Your profile

• Bachelor’s degree and a post-graduate degree such as a Master’s, MBA, CIIA or CFA would be an advantage.
• At least seven years’ investment advisory/management experience; client-facing experience.
• Ideally cross asset class experience with bias towards equities, derivatives, structured products and knowledge in alternative investments would be an additional asset.
• Fluency in Italian or Spanish, and English, both written and spoken. Fluency in Portuguese is an asset.
• Excellent technical knowledge across asset classes, investment vehicles and the mandate/product offering.
• Excellent understanding of portfolio construction, investment processes and risk management approaches.
• IT-proficient, including knowledge of relevant software packages, on-line information systems, front-end management and order-placing systems (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Adobe, Bloomberg, Avaloq, Profolio, etc.).
• Strong client-focused attitude and used to working under pressure.
• Excellent presentation skills.
• Proven team player but also able to work on one’s own.

Note

We will not accept any CVs via agencies

Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace.

Production Support agit comme un véritable hub de communication et de collaboration, favorisant le partage d’information, l’entraide et la montée en compétence collective.

Your role

• Coordonner des projets transverses impliquant plusieurs équipes (opérationnelles, IT, métiers), organiser et animer des séances de suivi, assurer la transmission et la clarté de l’information.
• Identifier, en lien avec les équipes opérationnelles, les axes d’amélioration des process et initier des projets pour optimiser l’efficacité et réduire les risques opérationnels des équipes de Transaction Processing.
• Participer activement à l’analyse, au testing business et au change management lors de la mise en place de nouveaux process.
• Dans le cadre de projet, s’assurer que les flux business et les processus sont documentés, que les procédures sont mises à jour ainsi que les supports de formation.
• Réaliser des contrôles récurrents de 2ème niveau
• Assurer l’onboarding des nouveaux clients de nos Business Lines PAM et PAS au niveau banque dépositaire
• Encourager la coopération et le partage d’expertise en sollicitant les interlocuteurs clés pour faire émerger des solutions concrètes et efficientes.

Your profile

• Bachelor en finance, systèmes d’information ou titre jugé équivalent.
• Expérience confirmée (5 ans minimum) dans le domaine bancaire, idéalement en coordination ou gestion de projets.
• Excellente connaissance des activités et flux opérationnels de banque dépositaire.
• Compétences en gestion de projet, business analyse, testing et change management.
• Maîtrise d’Avaloq et des outils financiers (un atout).
• Parfaite maîtrise du français et de l’anglais (écrit et oral).
• Maîtrise des outils informatiques MS Office ; Aisance avec les outils IA ; connaissance de Jira, Sharepoint, Wiki, Phyton, WBA Excel.

Your team

Les opérations assurent un traitement sécurisé et efficace des transactions bancaires et des fonds d'investissement de Pictet. Nos équipes veillent à ce que toutes les activités respectent les réglementations et gèrent les risques. En développant et en maintenant une infrastructure moderne et robuste, nous garantissons des services fiables et de haute qualité pour la gestion de patrimoine, la gestion d'actifs et de l’immobilier.
En tant que membre de l’équipe External Brokers Trade Processing, vous serez amené/e à traiter les opérations portant sur des produits standards (actions, obligations, fonds de placement, ETFs, etc…) effectuées par nos gérants externes et l’entité Pictet Asset Management (PAM), dans un environnement multisites.
La qualité du service offert et une attitude qui favorise la promotion des améliorations en continu jouent un rôle clef pour notre équipe, et seront attendues de vous.

Your role

- Comptabiliser les opérations DVP/RVP sur titres standards, avec l'envoi d'instructions aux sous-dépositaires en provenance des gérants d’actifs externes et de PAM.
- Assurer le suivi des opérations de règlement et traiter les défaillances en fonction de chaque marché afin de garantir un règlement dans les délais et d’éviter tout impact financier ou réglementaire.
- Traiter les incidents et les extournes liés à l’activité avec un regard critique, en proposant des solutions appropriées réduisant les risques opérationnels.
- Entretenir d’excellentes relations de travail avec les autres services et départements de la Banque, en apportant un support fiable et des solutions adaptées lors des sollicitations.
- Comprendre la chaîne de valeur front to back et contribuer à l’optimisation des processus, en veillant à la conformité aux procédures et à la réduction des risques sur l’ensemble du cycle de vie des opérations.

Your profile

- Bachelor/HES en finance, ou formation jugée équivalente.
- Expérience de 3 ans au minimum dans l’opérationnel bancaire de type trade processing.
- Excellente connaissance des activités de règlement des opérations contre paiement ainsi que des principales réglementations en vigueur (notamment CSDR relative aux dépositaires centraux)
- Connaissance du logiciel bancaire Avaloq, un atout
- Maîtrise des outils MS Office.
- Capacité à appliquer rigoureusement les procédures et directives, tout en gardant un esprit d’amélioration continue.
- Maîtrise du français et de l’anglais à l’écrit et à l’oral.
- Domicile en Suisse requis.
Votre rigueur, votre sens du détail et votre capacité d’adaptation seront tout autant appréciés que votre véritable esprit d’équipe et votre volonté d’assurer la satisfaction de nos clients internes et externes.

descriptionByLocale.it:
La tua squadra

Le operazioni garantiscono un trattamento sicuro ed efficiente dei fondi bancari e di investimento di Pictet. I nostri team garantiscono che tutte le attività siano conformi alle normative e gestiscano i rischi. Sviluppando e mantenendo un'infrastruttura moderna e robusta, garantiamo servizi affidabili e di alta qualità per la gestione degli asset, la gestione degli asset e il settore immobiliare.
In qualità di membro del team di Elaborazione dei Brokers Esterni, sarai tenuto a elaborare transazioni che coinvolgono prodotti standard (share, obbligazioni, fondi di investimento, ETF, ecc.) effettuati dai nostri manager esterni e dall'ente Pictet Asset Management (MAP) in un ambiente multi-sito.
La qualità del servizio offerto e un atteggiamento che promuove il miglioramento continuo giocano un ruolo chiave per il nostro team, e sarà previsto da voi.

Il tuo ruolo

- Registra le transazioni DVP/RVP su titoli standard, con le istruzioni inviate a sotto-depositi da gestori di asset esterni e WFP.
- Monitorare le operazioni di insediamento e affrontare i difetti in base a ogni mercato al fine di garantire la tempestiva insediamento ed evitare qualsiasi impatto finanziario o normativo.
- Affrontare incidenti e uscite legati alle attività con un aspetto critico, proponendo soluzioni appropriate che riducono i rischi operativi.
- Mantenere eccellenti rapporti di lavoro con altri dipartimenti e dipartimenti della Banca, fornendo un supporto affidabile e soluzioni appropriate per sollecitazioni.
- Comprendere la catena del valore anteriore a retro e contribuire all'ottimizzazione del processo, garantendo la conformità procedurale e la riduzione del rischio durante il ciclo di vita aziendale.

Il tuo profilo

- Bachelor/HES in finanza, o formazione equivalente.
- Esperienza di almeno 3 anni nella transazione di trading tipo bancario.
- Ottima conoscenza delle attività di liquidazione delle operazioni contro il pagamento e delle principali normative in vigore (in particolare CSDR sui depositari centrali)
- Conoscenza del software bancario Avaloq, un asset
- Mastery degli strumenti di MS Office.
- Capacità di applicare rigorosamente procedure e linee guida, pur mantenendo uno spirito di miglioramento continuo.
- Mastery di francese e inglese per iscritto e orale.
- Casa in Svizzera richiesta.
Il tuo rigore, il tuo senso di dettaglio e la tua capacità di adattamento saranno tanto apprezzati quanto il tuo vero spirito di squadra e la tua volontà di garantire la soddisfazione dei nostri clienti interni ed esterni.

Your team

Operations ensure secure and efficient processing of Pictet's banking and investment funds. Our teams ensure that all activities comply with regulations and manage risks. By developing and maintaining a modern and robust infrastructure, we guarantee reliable and high-quality services for asset management, asset management and real estate.
As a member of the External Brokers Trade Processing team, you will be required to process transactions involving standard products (shares, bonds, investment funds, ETFs, etc.) carried out by our external managers and the Pictet Asset Management (MAP) entity in a multi-site environment.
The quality of service offered and an attitude that promotes continuous improvement play a key role for our team, and will be expected from you.

Your team

The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented in
30 offices in financial centres worldwide, currently employing over 5000 people. Pictet has been present in London since 1980 and employs near 400 people.

Pictet Asset Management manages the assets of some of the world’s largest institutions,
financial intermediaries and their clients. Our culture welcomes independent thinkers and centres around investment excellence, a long-term perspective and a dedication to client service.

Our Securities Data Operations team provides investment instruments data expertise to
investment teams, securing data fundamentals, developing, and operating the data quality framework.

Your role

As part of our Operations department, you will be responsible for line management of our Securities Data Operations team consisting of 2 team members in London 1 in Geneva and 2 in Singapore.

You will oversee the daily setup and maintenance of investment securities, including pricing and reference data. You will also monitor deliverables linked to innovation, technology and business initiatives.

In time, you will be expected to develop and build the Data Operations function towards a Target Operating Model, and you will be considered as the Subject Matter Expert (SME).

• Ownership of all Data Operations BAU activities with a focus on risk control, efficiencies and improving overall effectiveness of the team:

• Secure daily data production tasks; delivering work of high quality and ensure BAU risk is kept to a minimum.

• Set up securities accurately and promptly to enable trading, managing exceptions as needed.

• Resolve issues/exceptions in a timely manner and escalate to
management as required.

• Continually improve and develop procedures/processes as the
business advances by presenting findings and recommendations to the team.

• In partnership with the Head of Data Operations work to define, deliver, and drive innovation and change management processes as required. For example, participate in the evolution of data management processes and the enhancement of our Enterprise Data Management (EDM) solution within an agile framework.

• Provide state of the art operational data expertise to support investment teams and build strong connections with business stakeholders including the data team based in Singapore.

• Develop team members and support their growth within the organisation.

Your profile

• Educated to degree level and relevant professional qualification(s), such as CFA, preferred.

jobs.description:
Your team

Corporate Functions includes the Group’s non-banking activities and employs more than 900 people. These functions are carried out by specialists with expertise across all business units, and include the Communications, Compliance, Finance, Human Resources, Information Security, Internal Audit, Legal, Risk, Strategy & Projects, and Tax departments.

This role reports to the Chief of Staff , Human Resources.

Your role

Support the HR and business evolution and ambition through advanced analytics and AI, delivering actionable insights that drive strategic people decisions and unlock organisational value. Translate complex people data into practical insights that support effective business and HR strategies, enabling HR to anticipate and understand key workforce trends – such as turnover, performance, compensation and engagement – by leveraging the latest in data science. Foster a culture where data-driven insights inform and enhance every aspect of the employee experience and organisational effectiveness. You will be responsible for:

• Developing and communicating a clear vision for advancing the HR function toward a data-driven, insight-led culture. Shaping the future of data and analytics in HR by identifying required skills, capabilities, and optimal ways of working across business lines and specialisms.
• Managing a small team, prioritising and reviewing requests, balancing workload, and actively coaching to build skills and capabilities.
• Critically assessing the HR analytics technology landscape, identifying opportunities for simplification, modernisation, and improvement, including the integration of AI-powered tools.
• Taking full ownership of HR metrics, continuously enhancing their value and relevance for business insight generation.
• Realising the full potential of analytics by establishing clear HR data governance and ensuring it is fit for purpose.
• Introducing and championing tools and platforms that significantly enhance the capabilities of HR and enable rapid generation of new insights.
• Expanding the scope and depth of descriptive analytics by developing analyses that provide enhanced insights into key HR metrics (e.g., turnover, DEI, talent).

The role will be based in Geneva or London.

Your profile

• At least 8-10 years of work experience.
• University degree in Engineering, Statistics, Data Science, or a related field.
• Proven track record in leading people analytics initiatives or establishing people analytics functions in complex organisations.
• Advanced knowledge of Tableau and Snowflake, as well as Python and other programming languages. Detailed understanding of modern data science/machine learning frameworks, with experience in cloud-based analytics environments.
• Experience with SAP and SuccessFactors would be advantageous.
• Recognised authority in data and analytics, with a strong grasp of the latest trends in AI, machine learning, and data science. Strong knowledge of the HR environment, topics and data across the employee life cycle.
• Proven ability to translate complex analytical findings into clear, actionable business insights for diverse audiences.
• Demonstrated ability to lead and develop a team while remaining hands-on with complex analytical work.
• Exceptional project management skills, managing processes, stakeholders, dependencies, and timelines closely.
• Strong stakeholder management abilities, with a talent for influencing and aligning others around innovative, data-driven approaches.
• Highly skilled in both supervised and unsupervised machine learning algorithms, and experienced in applying these to real-world HR challenges.
• Experience of working in a matrix organisation, and collaborating seamlessly with remote and cross-functional teams.
• Fluency in English is required. Knowledge of French would be beneficial but not essential.
• Based in Geneva or London. If Geneva based, must be a resident of Switzerland.

Note

Start date: to be discussed.
Reference: HPA/ CB/ DO

We will not accept any CVs via agencies.

Diversity & Inclusion

Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace.

Questo ruolo riferisce al Capo di Stato Maggiore, Risorse Umane.

Il tuo ruolo

Sostenere le risorse umane e l'evoluzione aziendale e l'ambizione attraverso analisi avanzate e AI, fornendo insight attuabili che guidano le decisioni strategiche delle persone e sbloccano il valore organizzativo. Traduci dati di persone complesse intuizioni pratiche che supportano strategie aziendali e HR efficaci, consentendo alle risorse umane di anticipare e comprendere le tendenze chiave della forza lavoro – come fatturato, performance, compensazione e impegno – sfruttando le ultime tendenze della data science. Promuovere una cultura in cui i dati guidati informano e valorizzano ogni aspetto dell'esperienza dei dipendenti e dell'efficacia organizzativa. Sarete responsabili di:

• Sviluppare e comunicare una visione chiara per promuovere la funzione HR verso una cultura basata sui dati e orientata alle informazioni. Definire il futuro dei dati e delle analisi nelle risorse umane identificando le competenze, le capacità e i modi ottimali di lavorare attraverso le linee di business e specializzazioni.
• Gestire un piccolo team, priorizzare e rivedere le richieste, bilanciare il carico di lavoro e allenare attivamente per costruire competenze e capacità.
• Valutazione critica del panorama delle tecnologie di analisi delle risorse umane, identificazione delle opportunità di semplificazione, modernizzazione e miglioramento, compresa l'integrazione degli strumenti alimentati dall'intelligenza artificiale.
• Prendendo la piena proprietà delle metriche HR, migliorando continuamente il loro valore e la pertinenza per la generazione di informazioni aziendali.
• Realizzare il pieno potenziale di analisi, stabilendo una chiara governance dei dati HR e assicurando che sia adatta a scopo.
• Introdurre e valorizzare strumenti e piattaforme che migliorano in modo significativo le capacità delle risorse umane e consentono una rapida generazione di nuovi insight.
• Ampliamento della portata e della profondità di analisi descrittiva attraverso lo sviluppo di analisi che forniscono una maggiore comprensione delle metriche chiave delle risorse umane (ad esempio, fatturato, DEI, talento).

• Almeno 8-10 anni di esperienza lavorativa.
• Laurea in Ingegneria, Statistica, Scienza dei dati, o un campo correlato.

• Einführung und Förderung von Tools und Plattformen, die die Fähigkeiten von HR erheblich verbessern und eine schnelle Generierung neuer Erkenntnisse ermöglichen.
• Erweiterung des Umfangs und der Tiefe deskriptiver Analysen durch die Entwicklung von Analysen, die bessere Einblicke in wichtige HR-Metriken bieten (z. B. Umsatz, DEI, Talent).

• Fortgeschrittene Kenntnisse von Tableau und Snowflake sowie Python und anderen Programmiersprachen. Detailliertes Verständnis moderner Data Science / Machine Learning Frameworks mit Erfahrung in Cloud-basierten Analyseumgebungen.

Votre équipe

Les fonctions corporatives comprennent les activités non bancaires du Groupe et emploient plus de 900 personnes. Ces fonctions sont exercées par des spécialistes ayant une expertise dans toutes les unités opérationnelles et comprennent les services des communications, de la conformité, des finances, des ressources humaines, de la sécurité de l'information, de la vérification interne, des services juridiques, du risque, de la stratégie et des projets et des services fiscaux.

Ce rôle relève du chef de cabinet, Ressources humaines.

Votre rôle

Soutenir l'évolution et l'ambition des RH et des entreprises au moyen d'analyses avancées et d'IA, en fournissant des informations concrètes qui stimulent les décisions stratégiques des personnes et débloquent la valeur organisationnelle. Traduire des données sur les personnes complexes en données pratiques qui appuient des stratégies efficaces d'affaires et de RH, permettant aux RH d'anticiper et de comprendre les principales tendances de la main-d'oeuvre – comme le roulement, le rendement, la rémunération et l'engagement – en tirant parti des dernières données scientifiques. Favoriser une culture dans laquelle les connaissances fondées sur les données informent et améliorent tous les aspects de l'expérience des employés et de l'efficacité organisationnelle. Vous serez responsable :

• Élaborer et communiquer une vision claire pour faire progresser la fonction RH vers une culture axée sur les données et axée sur les idées. Façonner l'avenir des données et de l'analyse en RH en déterminant les compétences, les capacités et les façons optimales de travailler dans les secteurs d'activité et les spécialités.
• Gérer une petite équipe, hiérarchiser et examiner les demandes, équilibrer la charge de travail et assurer un encadrement actif pour renforcer les compétences et les capacités.
• Évaluation critique du paysage technologique de l'analyse des ressources humaines, identification des possibilités de simplification, de modernisation et d'amélioration, y compris l'intégration d'outils alimentés par l'IA.
• S'approprier pleinement les mesures des RH, en améliorant continuellement leur valeur et leur pertinence pour la production de renseignements commerciaux.
• Réaliser le plein potentiel de l'analyse en établissant une gouvernance claire des données des RH et en veillant à ce qu'elle soit adaptée à ses besoins.
• Introduction et promotion d'outils et de plateformes qui améliorent considérablement les capacités des RH et permettent la production rapide de nouvelles idées.
• Élargir la portée et la profondeur de l'analyse descriptive en élaborant des analyses qui permettent de mieux comprendre les principales mesures des RH (p. ex., le roulement, l'IDD, le talent).

Le rôle sera basé à Genève ou à Londres.

Votre profil

• Au moins 8 à 10 ans d'expérience professionnelle.
• Diplôme universitaire en génie, en statistique, en sciences des données ou dans un domaine connexe.
• Expérience éprouvée dans les initiatives d'analyse des personnes ou l'établissement de fonctions d'analyse des personnes dans des organisations complexes.
• Connaissance avancée de Tableau et Snowflake, ainsi que de Python et d'autres langages de programmation. Compréhension détaillée des cadres modernes de science des données et d'apprentissage automatique, avec expérience dans les environnements d'analyse basés sur le cloud.
• L'expérience avec SAP et SuccessFactors serait avantageuse.
• Autorité reconnue en matière de données et d'analyse, avec une bonne compréhension des dernières tendances en matière d'IA, d'apprentissage automatique et de science des données. Connaissance approfondie de l'environnement, des sujets et des données des RH tout au long du cycle de vie des employés.
• Capacité éprouvée de traduire des constatations analytiques complexes en perspectives opérationnelles claires et réalisables pour divers publics.
• Capacité démontrée de diriger et de développer une équipe tout en restant pratique avec un travail analytique complexe.
• Compétences exceptionnelles en gestion de projet, gestion des processus, intervenants, dépendances et échéanciers.
• Fortes capacités de gestion des intervenants, avec un talent pour influencer et aligner les autres autour d'approches novatrices axées sur les données.
• Hautement qualifié dans les algorithmes d'apprentissage automatique supervisés et non supervisés, et expérimenté dans l'application de ceux-ci aux défis RH du monde réel.
• Expérience de travail dans une organisation matricielle et collaboration harmonieuse avec des équipes à distance et interfonctionnelles.
• La maîtrise de l'anglais est requise. La connaissance du français serait bénéfique mais non essentielle.
• Basé à Genève ou Londres. Si elle est basée à Genève, elle doit résider en Suisse.

Your team

Corporate Functions includes the Group’s non-banking activities and employs more than 900 people. These functions are carried out by specialists with expertise across all business units, and include the Communications, Compliance, Finance, Human Resources, Information Security, Internal Audit, Legal, Risk, Strategy & Projects, and Tax departments.

This role reports to the Chief of Staff , Human Resources.

Your role

Support the HR and business evolution and ambition through advanced analytics and AI, delivering actionable insights that drive strategic people decisions and unlock organisational value. Translate complex people data into practical insights that support effective business and HR strategies, enabling HR to anticipate and understand key workforce trends – such as turnover, performance, compensation and engagement – by leveraging the latest in data science. Foster a culture where data-driven insights inform and enhance every aspect of the employee experience and organisational effectiveness. You will be responsible for:

• Developing and communicating a clear vision for advancing the HR function toward a data-driven, insight-led culture. Shaping the future of data and analytics in HR by identifying required skills, capabilities, and optimal ways of working across business lines and specialisms.
• Managing a small team, prioritising and reviewing requests, balancing workload, and actively coaching to build skills and capabilities.
• Critically assessing the HR analytics technology landscape, identifying opportunities for simplification, modernisation, and improvement, including the integration of AI-powered tools.
• Taking full ownership of HR metrics, continuously enhancing their value and relevance for business insight generation.
• Realising the full potential of analytics by establishing clear HR data governance and ensuring it is fit for purpose.
• Introducing and championing tools and platforms that significantly enhance the capabilities of HR and enable rapid generation of new insights.
• Expanding the scope and depth of descriptive analytics by developing analyses that provide enhanced insights into key HR metrics (e.g., turnover, DEI, talent).

The role will be based in Geneva or London.

Your profile

• At least 8-10 years of work experience.
• University degree in Engineering, Statistics, Data Science, or a related field.
• Proven track record in leading people analytics initiatives or establishing people analytics functions in complex organisations.
• Advanced knowledge of Tableau and Snowflake, as well as Python and other programming languages. Detailed understanding of modern data science/machine learning frameworks, with experience in cloud-based analytics environments.
• Experience with SAP and SuccessFactors would be advantageous.
• Recognised authority in data and analytics, with a strong grasp of the latest trends in AI, machine learning, and data science. Strong knowledge of the HR environment, topics and data across the employee life cycle.
• Proven ability to translate complex analytical findings into clear, actionable business insights for diverse audiences.
• Demonstrated ability to lead and develop a team while remaining hands-on with complex analytical work.
• Exceptional project management skills, managing processes, stakeholders, dependencies, and timelines closely.
• Strong stakeholder management abilities, with a talent for influencing and aligning others around innovative, data-driven approaches.
• Highly skilled in both supervised and unsupervised machine learning algorithms, and experienced in applying these to real-world HR challenges.
• Experience of working in a matrix organisation, and collaborating seamlessly with remote and cross-functional teams.
• Fluency in English is required. Knowledge of French would be beneficial but not essential.
• Based in Geneva or London. If Geneva based, must be a resident of Switzerland.

Note

Reference: HPA/ CB/ DO

We will not accept any CVs via agencies.

Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace.
